Name: Rescue: After the Drop at the <Alias=TargetLocation> on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>
MissionBoardDescription: Pods are dropping on the <Alias=TargetLocation> again, second time this week. Three of ours are hurt from the last. Clear the crews, then the three.

LogEntries.Entry: Raiders are dropping onto the <Alias=TargetLocation> by pod for the second time this week. Three of its people were hurt in the last drop, and nobody can reach them until the pods are dealt with.
I cleared the pod crews at the <Alias=TargetLocation>. Now the three hurt in the last drop: the shoulder first, then the young one, then the ribs.
I stitched a gash across one settler's shoulder. Next, the young one with the ankle.
I strapped the ankle of a settler who sprained it diving clear. Last, the one with the ribs.
Pods came down on the <Alias=TargetLocation> again. I cleared the crews and treated the three hurt in the drop before.

Objectives.DisplayText: Clear the pod crews at the <Alias=TargetLocation>
Treat the settler with the shoulder wound
Treat the settler with the twisted ankle
Treat the settler with cracked ribs

Lines.ResponseText: One of their rounds caught my shoulder on the way down. It's not deep. I've been telling myself it's not deep.
[Give Med Pack] Let me see it. I've a med pack.
One. Two. Three. Four. I've lost count, and I'm not starting again, so tell me that's done.
Were you here for the first drop?
Both of them. The first one I didn't see coming. This one I hid from.
I dived clear and my ankle didn't come with me. They come in like falling stars, only they open.
[Give Med Pack] Foot up. This will take the swelling down.
That's better. I'm telling everyone you came down out of the sky as well. You didn't, but that's how I'm telling it.
After. Not while it was happening. Is that strange?
Did you see them come down? Did you?
You've seen to her? And the young one? Then I'm last, which is right. I'm only sore.
[Give Med Pack] You're more than sore. Hold still.
Ribs. I heard them go when I hit the ground. That's easier. Three down, three treated.
How many of you live here?
Fewer than last month. People leave after the first drop.
They're dropping on us again, second time this week. Three of ours are still down from the last one. Crews first, please, and then the three.
That's the drop dealt with. Three of ours, three med packs. The shoulder first, she's lost the most. Then the young one, then the ribs.
